summary: StudyFlow AI - end-to-end testing complete. 30/30 pytest backend tests passed covering auth, RBAC, document CRUD, AI summary/quiz generation (real Gemini API), quiz submission/scoring, progress aggregation, admin stats/users, cascading delete and regenerate. Frontend manually + scripted tested: Landing, Register, Login (admin), Dashboard upload, live status polling processing->ready (~15s), Document detail (key concepts), Take quiz flow, quiz submission, Progress page (score chart, by_document table), Admin panel (stats + users). Student vs admin nav correctly hides Admin link. All MongoDB responses exclude _id and user model omits password_hash.

issues: Console shows 401 from GET /api/auth/me on mount before login. Not a bug but noisy — could gate /me call with presence of token to reduce console noise.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses CORS_ORIGINS env var name in .env but reads FRONTEND_URL — both present and FRONTEND_URL points to the preview URL, so CORS works; consider unifying naming.
JSON extraction _extract_json in server.py is a simple heuristic; if AI ever wraps in ```json with trailing prose it may still crash. Consider try/except with explicit fallback + retry.
asyncio.create_task(_process_document(...)) is fire-and-forget; no retry/backoff on LLM failure — status stays 'failed' until manual /regenerate. Acceptable for MVP.
DocumentOut pydantic model declared but not used for response_model on list/get endpoints — responses return raw dicts. Not harmful but loses validation.
test_credentials: admin@studyflow.ai / Admin@123 (seeded); student accounts created during tests have prefix TEST_student_*
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created 2 test student users and 1 document (deleted at end). A UI-uploaded 'newton' text document remains in admin's library (from manual flow validation) with 1 quiz attempt (50%).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is reusable as regression (15s runtime, uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, exercises real LLM). Key testids discovered: login-email/login-password/login-submit, register-name/register-email/register-password, upload-dropzone, upload-file-input, doc-card-{id}, doc-open-{id}, doc-delete-{id}, status-{processing|ready|failed}, rename-btn, edit-summary-btn, regenerate-btn, start-quiz-btn, quiz-page, question-{i}, option-{i}-{j}, quiz-prev, quiz-next, quiz-submit. Nav: nav-library, nav-progress, nav-admin (admin-only), logout-button.
rca of the issue: No issues to RCA — app is fully functional on all requested features.
